claims.statement: make api-test spins up a clean test DB (separate from dev), applies migrations, runs go test ./tests/integration/... -race -cover against real GORM + real Redis + the 9Pay/OnePay mocks at localhost:9001/9002, and reports coverage.

Clock helpers SetServerTime/AdvanceServerTime/ResetServerTime/GetServerTime are the only way to advance time in tests because clock.Now() is the business clock and direct mocking of clock.Now() is forbidden.

Integration scenarios are organized per capability (flow_auth_user, flow_timesheet, flow_wallet, flow_disbursement, flow_flexpay, flow_attendance, flow_bcc_import) and exercise the full stack — handler, service, repository, event bus, asynq worker — so a regression in any layer surfaces here.
Test conventions: pageSize=200 for timesheet queries, findAvailableDateWithMin for date selection in fixtures, pre-test DB cleanup via docker exec payroll-mysql ... when needed.
